verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants that expose different versions of a feature 'as part of A/B and multivariate testing' [unleash-docs-8], so the assignment side of experiments is covered. The only metrics evidence is impact metrics, which gate or pause rollouts when error rates or latency cross thresholds [unleash-docs-14, unleash-docs-22]. Nothing shows comparing variations or declaring a winner on product metrics. Missing for 10: experiment results or analysis UI, statistical comparison of variants against business metrics, winner determination, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
